name: Booking Slot Selector
description: A compact booking selector with date cards, available time slots and explicit timezone context, using native radios for reliable keyboard selection.

props.name: timezone
props.description: Explicit timezone label. The host supplies correctly converted slot labels.

props.name: days
props.description: Ordered date cards and time slots; available:false disables a slot.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selection. Undefined enables internal state; null explicitly clears selection.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Selection only; the host validates availability and confirms the booking.

props.name: theme
props.description: Surface and ink palette; the demo stage follows the chosen theme.
